title: Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation

content.caseIdentity: Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corporation, AIR 1986 SC 180
content.holding: No individual can barter away or waive fundamental rights under Article 21; an undertaking given in court cannot estop a citizen from asserting the right to life and livelihood.
content.relevance: Applied non-waiver to Article 21 and rejected constitutional estoppel.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition Nos. 4610-4612 of 1981; 1985 INSC 155; (1985) 3 SCC 545; 1985 Supp (2) SCR 51.
